gui.movinglightblock.empty: Place a crafting table, furnace or chest
message.movinglightblock.not_owner: This light belongs to another player
message.movinglightblock.module_locked: Items are still stored inside. Remove them before changing the module.
tooltip.movinglightblock.summon.1: Right-click to summon a cube that follows you
tooltip.movinglightblock.summon.2: Only one per player; contents stay inside the item when picked up
tooltip.movinglightblock.summon.3: Put torches in its GUI to add light, up to 15
tooltip.movinglightblock.summon.stored: Contains stored items; restored when placed again
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.settings.de: Open mod config: following, brightness, pick-up key, etc.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.model.desc: Pick a rolling model from config/movinglightblock/models/.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.sound.desc: Set sounds for summon, landing, moving and idle; .ogg only.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.module.desc: Place a crafting table, furnace or chest here to switch mode.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.module.lock: Empty this mode's items before taking the module out; torches are exempt.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.preview.des: Shows the current model and torch light level.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.model_entry: Click to switch immediately; press F3 + T to reload resources.
Enter an .ogg file name from the sounds folder; blank means silent.
gui.movinglightblock.tooltip.sound_volum: Volume; blank or invalid keeps the previous value.
movinglightblock.configuration.enabled.t: Turn off to disable the following light block entirely.
movinglightblock.configuration.animation: Tumble the cube while it follows; off keeps it upright.
movinglightblock.configuration.passThrou: On: ignore block collisions. Off: collide with blocks but never block or push players.
movinglightblock.configuration.retractKe: Hold this combo while aiming at the cube to pick it up. Format: modifiers+key, default shift+right (Shift + right click).
movinglightblock.configuration.lightLeve: Light level for a newly summoned cube, default 0 (dark). Put torches in the cube's right GUI slot to add 1 light each, up to 15; the GUI value is saved with the cube and overrides this setting.
movinglightblock.configuration.yOffset.t: Height relative to the player's feet: 0 = feet, 1 = head, 2 = above head.
movinglightblock.configuration.followDis: How far you must walk before the first chase. After that it follows whenever you leave the stop radius.
movinglightblock.configuration.stopDista: Stops chasing once this close, so it never sits at your feet.
movinglightblock.configuration.chaseSpee: Speed in blocks per second; 5.6 is about sprint speed. Flies and follows vertically too.
movinglightblock.configuration.teleportD: If the cube ends up farther than this, it is moved back next to you.
